classes.name: Anthracnose
classes.recommendation: Apply Copper Oxychloride (0.2%) or Mancozeb at flushing and flowering; prune and incinerate blighted twigs 10 cm below necrotic margins.

classes.name: Gummosis
classes.recommendation: Scrape oozing cankers carefully; apply Bordeaux paste (1%) or Copper fungicide to infected trunk/branch wounds; improve soil drainage.

classes.name: Healthy
classes.recommendation: Maintain standard cashew orchard sanitation, balanced N-P-K nutrient application, and routine canopy scouting.

classes.name: Leaf Miner
classes.recommendation: Apply Neem Seed Kernel Extract (NSKE 5%) or Spinosad on tender flush shoots; avoid broad-spectrum pyrethroids to preserve natural eulophid parasitoids.

classes.name: Red Rust
classes.recommendation: Spray Copper Hydroxide (0.2%) or Bordeaux mixture (1%) during moist flush periods; prune overly dense inner canopy branches to boost airflow.
